Armoured truck hit on Route 9 — three suspects still at large
Witnesses describe a black van and a getaway on dirt bikes through the hills.
Shortly after 9pm, an armoured transport was forced off Route 9 near the quarry turn. Police say three masked suspects took an undisclosed number of cash bags before fleeing.
"They knew exactly when it would pass," said one trucker who stopped at the scene. Halcyon PD has asked anyone with dash-cam footage to come forward.
The department confirmed no one was seriously hurt.
Mayor Ortega promises new tram line to the harbour
The council votes Friday on the $4M plan.
Speaking on the steps of City Hall, Mayor Ortega said the tram would "connect the people who work at the docks with the city they keep running".
Critics on the council say the money should go to fixing potholes first.
Burger shack chain opens its third location
Owner Mira says the secret is the sauce — and the queue.
Two years ago it was a food truck. Today, Mira's opened its third restaurant on Grove Avenue, hiring twelve new staff.
"We'll do a fourth when the city lets us," Mira laughed.
Harbour Hawks win the street-ball final in overtime
A buzzer-beater from the half-court line sealed it.
A packed court at Hillside Park watched the Hawks come back from 11 down.
MVP Jordan Vale: "I just threw it and closed my eyes."
Inside the city's first rooftop cinema
Blankets, popcorn and the best view of the bay.
Every Thursday the old print works roof turns into a cinema for 80 people.
Tickets sell out in minutes — set an alarm.
Police chase ends in the bay — driver swims for it
What began as a routine traffic stop ended with a stolen sports car in the water at Pier 3.
The driver was pulled out by harbour patrol and arrested on the dock.
